persons.name: Dhatnarāja
persons.evidence: liṣitai (!) śrī 3 āryyāvareokiteśvarasyaṃ(!) caranaśevaka(!) , vajrācāryyaśrīdhatnarājaṃ riṣāyitaṃ

notes: The catalogue identified Āryāvalokiteśvara (śrī 3 āryyāvareokiteśvara) as donor, but this is the Buddhist deity Avalokiteśvara of whom the person describes himself as a devotee (caraṇasevaka). Dhatnarāja (possibly a corruption for Ratnarāja) is associated with both 'liṣitai' and 'riṣāyitaṃ' (likhāyitam), making it ambiguous whether he copied it himself or had it copied.
